task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands opening the door and taking the box, but the clauses contain no hard goal: both clauses are soft restrictions on key_lost, so nothing requires door_open or target_picked_up and FINAL_STATES is empty (rule-only warning is not valid here). Add a hard Existence(target_picked_up) and a hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) (the chain forces door_open). For the preference 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed': key_lost's own definition already embeds the door-closed condition (the event fires only when the door is not open), so the ban is a soft Absence(key_lost); drop the redundant soft Precedence(door_open, key_lost), keep the soft Absence(key_lost).
